content: Do I need to lift heavy to build muscle?

No, you don't have to lift heavy to build muscle. Research shows that muscle growth is similar across a wide range of loads, roughly 5 to 30 reps, as long as your sets are taken close to failure (about 0-3 reps left) and you do enough weekly volume. 💪

Heavy work still matters for your bench goal, though. Strength is specific, so you'll want to train the bench with heavier sets (around 3-8 reps) and use lighter, higher-rep sets for accessories. Ain't nothin' but a peanut!
